blocks.text: Luka Doncic couldn’t help but smile, the Los Angeles Lakers’ star clearly appreciative of the roars of a crowd saluting his incredible start to the season. “M-V-P!” “M-V-P!” “M-V-P!” That was the cry from the fans, over and over. He’s heard it before, countless times. The latest installment came Sunday — in Phoenix. That’s how good Doncic is right now: He’s turning what are ordinarily hostile road venues into temporary hubs of Lakers’ fandom.
